---
title: "Grammars Gone Mental"
anchor-sections: false
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: true
listing:
  id: posts
  contents: generated/posts.yml
  template: assets/listing-home.ejs
  fields: [date, title, author, categories, description, featured, ggm-draft, ggm-live, ggm-scheduled, ggm-order]
  sort: "ggm-order"
  type: default
  categories: false
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  max-description-length: 400
  page-size: 1000000
  feed: true
---

```{=html}
<form class="home-search" action="search.html" method="get" role="search">
  <label for="home-search-query">Search posts</label>
  <div class="home-search-controls">
    <input id="home-search-query" name="query" type="search" placeholder="Search posts" required>
    <button type="submit">Search</button>
  </div>
</form>
```

```{=html}
<script>
// Quarto also shows its empty-filter message for an initially empty listing.
// Only expose it when the visitor has actually selected a category filter.
function syncCategoryFilter() {
  const category = new URLSearchParams(location.hash.slice(1)).get('category');
  document.documentElement.toggleAttribute('data-ggm-category-filter', Boolean(category));
}
window.addEventListener('hashchange', syncCategoryFilter);
syncCategoryFilter();
</script>
```
